To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the synthesis and photochemical properties of a new photochromic derivative of thieno- [2,3-b]-thiophene are reported for the first time, and that this compound is not photochromic but undergoes an intense photoluminescence.

the photochromic properties of the 1,2-di(2-arylbenzothiazolyl)hexafluorocylopentenes were studied, and the synthesis of a novel derivative, which is not photochromic but is photoluminescent, is described.
1,2-bis{5-(benzothiazol-2-yl)-2- ethylthieno-[3,2-b]-thiophenyl}hexaflourocyclopentenes have been synthesized for the ﬁrst time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of photochromic derivatives of thienopyrrole, thienopyran, and thieno[2',3':5,6]pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyridines and their photochemical behavior.
the synthesis of photochromic derivatives of thienyl and thienothiophene.
synthesis of new photochromic compounds based on thieno[2.3-b]thieno- and thieno[ 3,2-b ]thiophene systems and with studying their photochemical properties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the photochemical properties of diheteroarylethylenes are strongly dependent on the nature of the heterocycle, the nature of the substituents on the heterocycles, and the nature of the bridging group.
, in general, photochromic diheteroarylethynes are not good photoluminescent materials.

the photochromic activity of dihetarylethylenic compounds is not determined solely by the nature of the heterocyclic fragments in the molecule, and the photochemical properties of the dihetarylethylene molecule as a whole must also be taken into account.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, for the first time, the possibility of using thieno[2′,3′:3,2]bisthiophene as a photochromic system has been demonstrated.

, in the series of 1,3,4,5,6,7-hexafluorocycl[2.2]bene derivatives with thienothiophene fragments in the side chains, only compounds with thieno[2′,3′:2,3]thieno[3′,2′:2, 3]thiophenes in the side chains have photochromic properties.
the photochromic properties of the dihetarylethylene derivatives of thienothiophene are determined by the position of the thienothiopyrylium ring relative to the thienothienopyrylium one.
The main takeaway from our work is that

photochromic compounds containing thieno[2',3':5,6]thieno[3',2':5,6]-bis(thiophene) (BTBTBT) as a chromophoric unit have a much higher quantum yield for fluorescence than analogous compounds containing thienothiophene (TT).

the presence in a photochromic molecule of a substituent that is able to undergo a photochemical reaction, even if it is a weak electron donor, may lead to an increase in the rate of photoconversion of the photochromic center.
the presence of the 2,2′-dithiophene fragment in the molecule is the main factor responsible for the photoconversion and photochromic properties of the compounds under consideration.
